import json
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
d=json.load(open('coverage.json'))
files=[f['file'] for f in d['frames']]
print(len(files))
per=12
for k in range(0,len(files),per):
    chunk=files[k:k+per]
    W,H=620,220
    sheet=Image.new('RGB',(W*3,(H+16)*4),'white')
    for i,f in enumerate(chunk):
        im=Image.open(f).convert('RGB').resize((1920,1080)).crop((340,560,1580,1000)).resize((W,H))
        x=(i%3)*W; y=(i//3)*(H+16)
        sheet.paste(im,(x,y+16))
        ImageDraw.Draw(sheet).text((x+3,y+2),f,fill='red')
    sheet.save('/workspace/c%02d.png'%(k//per))
EOF
